subject: Pricing discovery: inference economics & competitive sensitivity
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finlytics.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@finlytics.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T15:00:00Z
Subject: Pricing discovery: inference economics & competitive sensitivity

Hi Alex / Samantha —

Thanks again for hopping on earlier. Quick recap from our call + the asks I promised I'd follow up on: 

- Quick summary of FinLytics' current + near-term forecast:
  • Current steady-state: ~50M tokens/month (inference requests for summarization + extraction pipelines)
  • Expected growth: ramp to ~300M tokens/month within 9–12 months if the new ingest pipeline goes live
  • Critical SLOs: median latency < 350ms for short prompts; peak concurrency ~600 rps

- commercial constraints / target economics you mentioned:
  • Total monthly inference budget target: ~$3k–$5k per 100k users (rough bucketed metric)
  • Target unit price: you flagged wanting something in the low double-digits per million tokens (you said $12–$18/1M tokens as a reference)

Requests / next steps from our side:
1) Can you confirm the 50M current / 300M 12mo number as final? If you have the usage-by-prompt CSV, please attach (I referenced finlytics-usage-estimate.xlsx).
2) Please tell us which competitor pricing you’re currently benchmarking (OpenAI, Anthropic, HostX?) and any current committed discounts.
3) Would you be open to a 3-month pilot at a blended pilot price while we validate batching/kv-cache savings (this is where we typically get another ~20–35% effective drop)?

I'll attach a short competitive sensitivity note and a baseline Redwood pricing sketch — see attached redwood-pricing-deck.pdf. High level: with the batching + quantization profile we discussed, we can show a path to sub-$10 effective /1M tokens in many workloads, but we should validate on your prompt mix.

Proposed short timeline: pilot kickoff next week -> usage validation 2–3 weeks -> committed pricing discussion week 5.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick alignment call after you confirm the usage numbers.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales (West) | Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0176 | hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-pricing-deck.pdf (15 pages), finlytics-usage-estimate.xlsx (placeholder)
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finlytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@finlytics.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T09:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Pricing discovery: inference economics & competitive sensitivity

Thanks Hannah — appreciated the clear recap. Confirming numbers:

- Current: ~50M tokens/month (production summarization + a smaller extraction job)
- Ramp plan: we expect ~200–350M/month within 9–12 months depending on product release cadence; 300M is a reasonable planning target for us.

Competitive pricing notes:
- OpenAI (gpt-4-32k style pricing equivalent): roughly $20–$25 / 1M tokens for the mix we're running today (we're on a committed tier through our SI partner, effective price closer to $18/1M).
- Anthropic (Claude equivalent): closer to $22–$28 / 1M tokens.
- HostX/self-hosted variants (managed): we have an inbound quote that shows $6–$9 /1M if we take on more ops risk and run on reserved infra.

Target: From our CFO perspective, we want to get below $12 /1M on committed volume to hit unit economics for new features. For pilot we can tolerate $15–$18 /1M if Redwood demonstrates the batching/km savings and latency SLAs.

I've attached a quick usage dump. Will also drop a short note to procurement on required contract terms if the price looks reasonable.

—Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Platform Engineering, FinLytics
alex.mercer@finlytics.com
Attachments: finlytics-usage-estimate.xlsx
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@finlytics.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha.li@finlytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T18:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Pricing discovery: inference economics & competitive sensitivity

Alex — thanks for the numbers and the color on competitive benchmarks. Quick sanity-check + a short Redwood benchmark map so you can see where we'd land given your targets: 

- Your target: sub-$12 /1M on committed volume = clear ask. Pilot tolerance $15–$18/1M.

Redwood sketch (ballpark, presuming the 300M committed volume and standard long-context summarization mix):
• Hosted Redwood baseline (no quantization / standard batching): $18–$20 /1M tokens
• Hosted Redwood + optimized batching + KV-prefix caching: effective $13–$15 /1M tokens (we see ~15–25% token savings from prefix caching on summarization workloads)
• Redwood + quantized model variants (customer-validated) + prescriptive batching + reserved capacity: blended $8–$11 /1M tokens (this is the committed-volume target we can get to with a 12–24 month reservation or committed contract)

Competitors for reference (your numbers roughly match what we see):
• OpenAI: $18–$25 /1M (depends on model/commit)
• Anthropic: $20–$28 /1M
• Managed self-host (HostX): $6–$10 /1M but with ops tradeoffs (support, SLA, security posture)

Recommendation / ask: 
1) Pilot: offer a 6-week pilot at $15 /1M (blended) while we validate the 20–30% effective savings via batching + KV caching on your real traffic. Pilot would include instrumentation (token-level cost breakdown + latency dashboard).
2) If pilot validates at least 15% effective savings, move to a 12-month committed contract with a target blended price of $9–$10 /1M and a standard reserved-capacity SLA.
3) For procurement: we'd require a short SOW + 60-day invoice terms for pilot; committed contract would map to standard Redwood Dedicated terms (reservation and supported tier).

Next steps: if you can show procurement is comfortable with pilot terms, I can loop in legal/finance and send a pilot SOW + PO template.

I'll also run this by our pricing desk (cc Karthik) to lock in the pilot quote formally.

—Hannah
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-23T01:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Pricing discovery: inference economics & competitive sensitivity — pilot pricing ask / approval

Karthik / Marissa — forwarding the thread with FinLytics. Highlights: target is to get them below $12 /1M on committed volume (300M/month plan). Customer will accept $15–$18 /1M for pilot.

Proposal I'm asking to approve:
- 6-week pilot at $15 /1M (blended), include instrumentation + 2 dedicated onboarding sessions (solutions eng + runtime tuning)
- If pilot shows >=15% effective per-token savings, convert to 12-month committed contract at $9.50 /1M (blended) with standard Redwood Dedicated terms and 30% usage ramp protection clause.

Related commercial guardrails I request:
- Approve a one-time pilot discount of 25% off our public hosted list for this account, and allow a conversion credit equal to the pilot spend applied to the first invoice of the committed term.
- Max credit exposure: $75k (we should cap conversion credit).

Deal metadata: RDW-2027-0421-FIN, expected ARR if converted ~ $3.6M/year based on 300M tokens @ $9.50/1M.

Can you confirm asap so I can share pilot SOW + PO template with Alex.

—Hannah

Onward the original thread below for context.

Hannah — thanks, the plan looks good. Procurement is okay to move forward with the 6-week pilot at $15 /1M as long as we get the instrumentation dashboard and an SLA addendum on latency. I'll expect the pilot SOW + PO template this week.

I'll also loop in our procurement lead (Samantha) to coordinate contract terms.

—Alex
